unsupported.serverless: Bounded collection types, groups, retention and application SEARCH workspaces are implemented; identity/private-endpoint adapters and warm tiers are outside the developer scope.
unsupported.ingestion: The bounded HTTP ingestion profile is implemented. VPC/resource-policy APIs, customer KMS keys and additional source/sink plugins remain unavailable.
unsupported.dashboards: Upstream Dashboards is not bundled; the local workspace implements Discover, data views, saved searches and Dev Tools
unsupported.nativePlugins: Native engine plugins are unavailable in the embedded interpreter
unsupported.applications: IAM applications and shared SEARCH workspaces are implemented; Identity Center/SAML/Cognito, presigned browser login sessions, cross-account source roles, customer KMS, additional direct-query backends and ML capabilities are outside the developer scope.
unsupported.operations: Upgrades, replication/migration and VPC connectivity remain unavailable; embedded DIRECT cross-cluster search, snapshots, maintenance and dictionary packages are implemented.

vectors.query: top-level knn with k and optional filter; float vectors only

metrics.sampling: resource activation and completed gateway/local query requests; no idle heartbeat

encryption.execution: SQLite in memory, authenticated encrypted snapshots and transaction journal
encryption.keyManagement: Resource-owned local keys; not AWS KMS
encryption.boundary: Search documents, mappings, aliases, templates and security records; no plaintext SQLite, WAL or temporary search files
encryption.nodeToNode: Single-process memory calls; no inter-node network channels

security.storage: Encrypted password verifiers and security metadata

serverless.capacity: Four concurrent local requests per allocated OCU, capped at 32 per pool/class. Separate group pools independent of ungrouped account pool. NextGen minimum zero releases admission allocation after 10 idle minutes; encrypted engine memory remains resident and wake is immediate.
serverless.retention: Time-series ingestion age, 24h–3650d, longest literal resource match; NoMinIndexRetention; encrypted durable timestamps; expiry before requests and every minute.
serverless.typeRestrictions: Time-series and Classic vectors require generated IDs and reject updates; NextGen vectors permit custom IDs. SEARCH/TIMESERIES reject k-NN indexes. Groups admit one collection type in this local profile.

ingestionJobs.scope: One-time S3 jobs for active NextGen SEARCH/VECTORSEARCH; same account/Region; caller execution identity
ingestionJobs.authorization: Original caller revalidated; key/session revocation/expiry and role replacement fail; normal S3 IAM/bucket and AOSS network/IAM/data policies
ingestionJobs.checkpoint: Separate encrypted work store, frozen/pinned listing, atomic object admission, per-record durable acknowledgment; restart resumes; source-derived IDs; at least once
ingestionJobs.failures: Real failure-index records contain source metadata/ordinal and stable reason; default target-ingestion-failures; no document contents in control metadata
ingestionJobs.cancellation: Durable CANCELLING/CANCELLED; stops pending work, permits in-flight commit, preserves indexed documents
ingestionJobs.retries: Transient 429/5xx up to ten times, 1–60s backoff with activeAlerts; authorization errors terminal
unsupported: Continued delegation after original credential expiry
Deleting obsolete documents when a source object shrinks

ingestionStreams.scope: NextGen SEARCH/VECTORSEARCH; dedicated same-account/Region standard SQS queue; zero to five source buckets; optional per-bucket initial scan
ingestionStreams.authorization: Caller iam:PassRole; aoss.amazonaws.com with actual source ARN/account; fresh trust/identity and IAM/resource/data/network checks; bounded reusable service credentials
ingestionStreams.checkpoint: Separate encrypted listing/message/receipt/admitted records/acks; completion before DeleteMessage; 1000 completed message IDs; stale receipts recover by redelivery; at least once
ingestionStreams.source: Current object must match notification ETag/size/version; stale events become failure-index records; no historical version overwrite
ingestionStreams.deletion: Durable DELETING/DELETED; pending work stops, in-flight commits may finish; encrypted work/key removed; documents, bucket and queue retained
ingestionStreams.retries: Source, destination, trust and storage errors retry indefinitely with 1–60s backoff and activeAlerts
unsupported: Removing obsolete ordinals when an object shrinks

ingestionProfile.delivery: at-least-once; encrypted durable per-item retries, original configuration retained
ingestionProfile.deadLetter: same-account/same-Region S3; role and bucket policy enforced
ingestionProfile.capacity: 1–8 local units: four concurrent requests and ten delivery records/tick/unit; backlog allocation respects min/max

logging.destination: Existing /aws/vendedlogs/ group in configured account and pipeline Region
logging.permissions: Caller Create/Update/DeleteLogDelivery and delivery.logs.amazonaws.com resource policy; policies/groups are not auto-created
events: per-item delivery errors without event contents
logging.failure: Best-effort delivery with persistent failure diagnostics; ingestion progress continues; failed log events are not replayed
logging.sourceArn: Local log stream ARN for AWS vended-log resource-policy conditions

s3Source.scope: One same-account/Region bucket, pipeline role; one literal prefix and up to 20 excluded suffixes; optional UTC time window or relative range
s3Source.codec: Strict UTF-8 NDJSON objects, none/gzip compression, acknowledgments required, no source deletion
s3Source.checkpoint: Encrypted frozen listing and atomic event admission; cursor advances only after all object events reach sink/DLQ; process restart resumes; explicit Stop/Start creates a new run
s3Source.identity: S3 version pinned where available; ETag, size and lastModified checked; GetObjectVersion required for pinned versions
unsupported: Source deletion, SSE-C and automatic archive restore
Metadata expressions, native coordinator topology and native performance parity
s3Source.console: S3 blueprint and measured scan progress; no HTTP test form or ingest endpoint for S3 sources

dynamodbSource.scope: One same-Region table in the installation account, managed-domain sink; NEW_IMAGE/NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES; LATEST/TRIM_HORIZON; acknowledgments required
dynamodbSource.checkpoint: Encrypted atomic batch/metadata admission; pinned stream/shard/numeric cursor; advances after sink/DLQ; Stop/Start and restart preserve it; trim/replacement blocks
dynamodbSource.authorization: Fresh pipeline role with DescribeTable/DescribeStream/GetShardIterator/GetRecords, DynamoDB resource policies and normal domain IAM/FGAC
dynamodbSource.writes: New images indexed; REMOVE deletes; stable metadata ID/action and external versions; stale/replayed source version conflicts acknowledged
dynamodbSource.version: Local table sequence up to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; differs from native timestamp/tie-breaker encoding; dedicated index required
dynamodbSource.values: String partition/sort keys without |, joined by |, <=512 bytes; JSON attribute conversion; base64 binary; <=15 significant digits and safe integer magnitude; unsupported precision fails
dynamodbSource.console: DynamoDB stream and snapshot blueprints; measured export ARN/offset/completion and CDC status; no HTTP intake

initialExport.scope: Optional export.s3_bucket/s3_prefix with LATEST; PITR enabled; actual DynamoDB FULL_EXPORT to same-account/Region S3
initialExport.authorization: Role DescribeContinuousBackups/ExportTableToPointInTime/DescribeExport and exact-key S3 PutObject at admission; DynamoDB service bucket policy at writes; role S3 GetObject on ingestion
initialExport.checkpoint: Pin cursor/time/token/baseline before export; persist ARN; verify and pin artifact digest; encrypted 100-record batches; snapshot offset advances only after all sink/DLQ acks; then CDC from pinned cursor
initialExport.version: All snapshot records use pre-cursor sequence (including zero); later CDC external versions supersede; dedicated empty index required
initialExport.failures: Failed export, changed artifacts or expired/changed stream block; permissions retry; export files/jobs retained after pipeline deletion

snapshots.repositories: S3 in the domain account/Region; one writer per bucket/prefix, optional read-only readers
snapshots.format: stacksim-search-snapshot-v1 JSON/gzip; not native Lucene snapshot files
authorization: FGAC snapshot/repository and unrestricted index grants
snapshots.restore: durable asynchronous job; atomic creation of new indexes; bounded RE2 rename; aliases/templates optional

maintenance.mapping: Search restart reopens storage; node reboot also rebinds the same HTTPS endpoint. Both drain active requests and discard in-memory search contexts. No host reboot or separate native process is claimed.

logs.destination: Existing CloudWatch Logs groups in the configured StackSim account and domain Region; es.amazonaws.com resource policy required
logs.thresholds: warn/info/debug/trace for index.search.slowlog.threshold.query and index.indexing.slowlog.threshold.index; -1 disables; 0ms–24h
logs.timing: Whole embedded request elapsed time for each touched index, not native per-shard query/fetch timings
logs.privacy: No request bodies, query strings, documents or credentials
logs.failure: Best effort; diagnostic failure counters persist; rejected events are not replayed and writes remain acknowledged

audit.requires: Domain publishing and encrypted FGAC security capture both enabled; existing CloudWatch Logs policy
audit.authorization: Security master only for configuration; capture uses each current REST identity

ingestPipelines.execution: index/create and bulk; request or default pipeline then final pipeline; _none skips the default only
ingestPipelines.persistence: Resource-owned engine metadata, encrypted when the domain is encrypted; included in snapshot global state
ingestPipelines.failure: Per-item bulk outcomes; document/mapping changes roll back together; on_failure and ignore_failure supported
unsupported: updates on indexes with configured pipelines

appsync.configuration: Existing same-account/same-Region managed domain HTTPS endpoint and AppSync service role
appsync.resolvers: VTL UNIT and function stages; 2017-02-28 JSON request documents with GET/PUT/POST/HEAD/DELETE

sql: WHERE comparisons, AND/OR/NOT, IN, BETWEEN, LIKE, IS NULL
queryLanguages.security: Current IAM/domain policy and resolved index permissions; DLS/FLS before relational operations; FGAC changes invalidate cursors

searchPipelines.semantics: Current index/DLS/FLS before candidates and normalization; one shard per local index; existing lexical scores and exact float vectors; full authorized matching union for counts/aggregations; per-index bounded ranking candidates
searchPipelines.persistence: Engine transaction metadata, encrypted with the domain; optional snapshot global state

indexStateManagement.scope: Managed domains only; embedded lifecycle interpreter
indexStateManagement.execution: One action or transition per interval; durable atomic effects/checkpoint; resumes after restart
indexStateManagement.policyRevisions: Pinned on attachment; explicit queued change_policy applies a new revision; deleting a definition does not stop attached jobs
indexStateManagement.templates: Highest-priority match on new index creation; equal-priority policies reject creation
indexStateManagement.security: Current FGAC execution identity/roles; actual index action and rollover target grants; normal domain/IAM request gates
indexStateManagement.sizeSemantics: Committed live JSON source bytes, including unrefreshed documents; not segment size
indexStateManagement.ageSemantics: Persisted index creation time; attachment time for older indexes without metadata; restore time for restored indexes
indexStateManagement.snapshotSemantics: Policies, jobs and execution identities are excluded from portable snapshots

packages.source: Same-account, same-Region S3; caller GetObject and bucket-policy authorization; current readable UTF-8 object
packages.storage: AES-256-GCM protected immutable versions; no dictionary plaintext in the control catalog
packages.publication: Durable asynchronous imports, associations and deletion; queued work resumes on restart; failed associations retain their last working version
packages.sharing: Create-time vending plus ADD/REMOVE/OVERRIDE account or GLOBAL scope; removal prevents new associations without revoking existing copies
packages.versioning: Imports do not change associations; reassociation installs the latest available version. Index and non-updateable search filters remain pinned; updateable synonym search filters use the active association. Snapshots carry version references, not dictionary text.
unsupported: Executable ZIP plugins, package licenses/configuration and native plugin installation
Customer KMS encryption and cross-account/cross-Region S3 imports
Close/open analyzer refresh; use a new index for pinned analysis
Restoring dictionary-dependent indexes without the matching associated versions

customAnalysis.dictionaries: Inline or associated analyzers/<PackageID>; single-term synonym rules, directional or equivalent; no filesystem access
unsupported: Native tokenization parity and language/stemmer/graph plugins
Multiword synonym rules, character filters and scripts
Mutable analysis settings or updateable index filters

automaticBackups.scope: Managed domains; hourly, checked once per minute; delayed work captures current data without inventing missed historical backups
automaticBackups.repositoryType: stacksim-automatic (explicit local type, not a fictitious S3 bucket)
automaticBackups.storage: Separately keyed AES-256-GCM immutable portable JSON/gzip copies; protected even when live search storage is unencrypted
automaticBackups.authorization: Ordinary domain/IAM and FGAC repository/snapshot permissions; unrestricted restore index grants
automaticBackups.recovery: Protected bytes precede durable catalog publication; unfinished material intents are reconciled on restart; retention removes retired materials only after publishing references
automaticBackups.deletion: Automatic copies are owned and removed by their domain; user-owned S3 snapshots remain independent
limitations: Full portable copies rather than native incremental segments
Capacity may expire snapshots sooner than 14 days
No manual create/delete/unregister or schedule customization
Security, workspaces and execution jobs are excluded
Restoring custom analysis needs associated dictionary versions
Missing backup keys disable backup restore and scheduling without disabling live search

insights.observation: On read; actual domain/storage, backup, enabled log delivery, latest failed configuration/maintenance and measured capacity
insights.feedback: Persisted latest Up/Down and optional 1000-character text; does not dismiss
limitations: No background observation or AWS fleet predictions
Resolved history pruned before active records

lambdaProducers.access: Execution-role SigV4 over verified HTTPS; per-invocation DescribeDomain discovery; normal IAM/domain policy and FGAC
lambdaProducers.cloudWatchLogs: Existing subscription and asynchronous Lambda delivery with base64/gzip envelopes, bounded index-scoped bulk writes and stable IDs
lambdaProducers.failure: HTTP and per-item failures fail invocation; durable Lambda retries; example SQS dead-letter queue
unsupported: Serverless or VPC producers in this example

differences: Tombstones retained until index deletion under 100000-record limit; no timed gc_deletes
Snapshots preserve live document versions but omit tombstones and source checkpoints

authentication.dashboardAdministrators: * or one IAM role ARN; unset grants no dashboard administrator privileges
authentication.standalone: Memory-only IAM credentials; no cookie session or presigned /_login/ adapter

applications.storage: Resource-owned AES-256-GCM saved objects; source documents remain in their owning domain/collection
applications.sources: Current same-account, same-Region domain/collection generations; queries preserve caller IAM and source FGAC/DLS/FLS or AOSS data policy
applications.attachments: AttachDataSource accepts domains; PENDING resolves when app and domain are active; SEARCH workspaceConfiguration or existing workspaceId; 24-hour pending timeout
applications.collectionNetwork: Public network policies or SourceServices application.opensearchservice.amazonaws.com; the latter grants no public ingress
applications.workspaces: Local authenticated context/workspaces/query routes; shared saved objects per workspace and pinned source generation; administrator gates saved-object writes and workspace creation

directQuery.execution: Actual CloudWatch Logs SQL/PPL jobs over segmented events; no copied index
directQuery.querySurface: Explicit local /_stacksim/api/opensearch/direct-query/{name}/{start|get|cancel} routes signed with es; native direct-query wire protocol is not claimed
directQuery.authorization: Caller IAM opensearch query actions plus creator identity or explicit same-account data source policy; current role trust and logs:StartQuery permission are rechecked at scheduling and result/cancel access
directQuery.associations: 1–20 active same-account, same-Region collections pinned by generation; interactive Logs queries do not read collection indexes
directQuery.storage: Configuration catalog and resource-owned query identifiers on real Logs jobs; seven-day result retention

crossClusterSearch.operations: Seven connection operations and seven shared legacy facades
crossClusterSearch.scope: Managed domains across accounts/Regions in this installation and partition; pinned resource generations
crossClusterSearch.authentication: IAM, source HTTP authorization, explicit destination es:ESCrossClusterGet resource-policy grant plus IAM evaluation, current per-domain FGAC search/search_shards with DLS/FLS
crossClusterSearch.query: GET/POST /local-index,alias:remote-index/_search; global embedded DSL/aggregations/sort/source projection/exact k-NN
crossClusterSearch.skipUnavailable: Optional destination availability failures only; permission errors, revoked connections and missing indexes fail
crossClusterSearch.storage: One source-owned durable catalog record with account/Region-scoped inbound/outbound views; no document copying

configurationComparison.scope: Same-account domains, same partition, source-Region request; IAM es:CompareDomainConfiguration required on both domains
configurationComparison.semantics: Actual current engine metadata; object key order and ISM timestamps ignored, arrays ordered; password verifier differences reported with Policy=redacted and no values
configurationComparison.truncation: Complete item counts, Truncated=true when item/field/value/detail limits omit details

scope.purpose: Learn and test application code against real bounded local search
